snippet.title: Grandpa Has No Umbrella! ☂️ Be Kind to People | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Oh no! It's raining, and Grandpa has no umbrella! What should we do?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) said: "Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to people."

So let's be kind: share your umbrella and keep Grandpa dry, help carry the heavy bags, and give your little brother a big hug and share your toy. When we are kind to people, Allah is kind to us!

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 7376 (narrated by Jarir bin Abdullah, Radi Allahu Anhu): https://sunnah.com/bukhari:7376

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: DesignwithRiyas on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-112361/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. Only an ordinary family is drawn.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at
